name: od-axum-export
title: Export to Axum
description: Turns a working htmx + Alpine prototype (htmx-alpine-prototype template) into a runnable Rust Axum fragment server that answers the same routes with the same fragments.

description_i18n.en: Turns a working htmx + Alpine prototype (htmx-alpine-prototype template) into a runnable Rust Axum fragment server that answers the same routes with the same fragments.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把可运行的 htmx + Alpine 原型（htmx-alpine-prototype 模板）转换为可运行的 Rust Axum 片段服务器，以相同的片段响应相同的路由。

query.en: Export this htmx + Alpine prototype to a Rust Axum server: run the exporter, build and run the crate, and confirm every flow works against the real server.
query.zh-CN: 把这个 htmx + Alpine 原型导出为 Rust Axum 服务器：运行导出脚本，构建并运行 crate，确认所有流程在真实服务器上都能工作。
